tenderSchedule.title: Raising of Polythene bagged seedlings at Londa Nursery (10x16) & (8x12) at Londa Range under TEGA SIRI head
tenderSchedule.description: Raising of Polythene bagged seedlings at Londa Nursery (10x16) & (8x12) at Londa Range under TEGA SIRI head
tenderSchedule.locationName: KFD ACF Territorial Sub Division Office Khanapur

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: Last five years achieved at least in two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. One time of Indent amount.

Satisfactoriy completed at least 50% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 50% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).For Reserved Tenders Satisfactoriy completed at least 25% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 25% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).
Each Tenderer should further demonstrate Availability of owning the following Key and critical equipment for this work.GPS and other Survey instruments And Soil excavator such as Hitachi/Jcb
Line of credit including E-tender Indent No & addressed to undersigned not less then 30% of the Tender amount received from any Nationalized Bank
Contractor should be registered as Forest Contractor in Karnataka Forest Department for the year 2026-27
Income tax returned filed documents for the last three financial year to be enclosed.
A copy of GST no registered under GST act.
Details of goods carriage vehicle, labor service, list of machineries & materials, equipments owned by the contractor.
For address proof any only copy of Adhar,PAN Card, Voter ID, Telephone bill within two months, Ration Card, Bank Pass book, ID issued any Corporation/TP to be uploaded).
A copy of List of Skilled, semi skilled, un skilled labours including EPF & ESI details to be uploaded) along with copy of Registration in Labour Department, EPF & ESI Registration Certificate
Caste Certificate Compulsory (for reserved category tenders)
Submission of Bid capacity (5 years Turnover) Amount of works contracted by contractors in all departments in the year 2026-27 (indent-wise) and turnover for the last five years

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Raising of Polythene bagged seedlings Londa Nursery 8x12

itemList.description: Cost of 4"x6" seedlings for transplanting into 8"x12" PB's
Purchase of HDPE woven sack bags including 18%GST (Rate approved by CCF, Belagavi)
Procurement of 0.9225 cum. Farm Yard Manure / Compost, 0.9225 cum. of Sand and 1.845 cum of Redearth. (4.20 cmtr. required for 8"x12" minus 0.51 cmtr. of transplanted 4"x6" bag).
Mixing of ingredients, filling the polythene bags and duly arranging in rows after scraping the earth.
Transplanting of 4" x 6" size bagged seedlings into 8" x 12" size bags.
Watering to the Polythene bagged seedlings twice a day from 01-12-2026 to 31-03-2027 (121 (days)
Weeding in the polythene-bagged seedlings.
Shifting and grading the polythene-bagged seedlings.

Procurement of plant protection and growth promotion materials / compounds, their application, nursery pumpset fuel / maintainence / electricity bill of pumpset and other unforeseen items and charges, Etc

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Raising of Polythene bagged seedlings at Londa Nursery 10x16

itemList.description: Procurement of seedlings for transplanting into 10"x16"
Cost of HDPE woven sack bags including 18% GST

Procurement of 1.91 cum. Farm Yard Manure / Compost, 1.91 cum, of Sand and 3.82 cum of Redearth l.e. totally 7.64 cmtr. (Ingredient ratio FYM: Sand: Red earth = 1:1:2) (8.72 cmtr needed for 10" x16" minus 1.08 cmtr of transplanted 5"x8" bag).
Mixing the ingredients, filling the polythene bags and arranging in rows after scraping the earth.

Transplanting of 4” x 6” or 5” x 8” size bagged seedlings into 10” x 16” size bags after removal of the seedlings along with the trimmed ball of earth [When transplanting is done the ingredients of bag from which transplanted should be deducted].

Cost of Collection of 8-10 ft long stakes of ‘chewa’ or split dowga bamboos from departmental forest / plantation for providing vertical support to each plant inclusive of delivery at nursery site (for tall seedlings only).
Tying of plant to the vertical stake, and pruning of buds as it grows, not more frequent than once a fortnight (for tall seedlings only).
Watering to the polythene-bagged seedlings twice a day from: 01-09-2026 to 31-03-2027= Limitted 243 days
Weeding in polythene bags.
Shifting and grading the polythene-bagged seedlings.

Procurement of plant protection and growth promotion materials/compounds, their application, nursery pumpset fuel/maintainence/ electricty bill of pumpset and other and Purchase of Black Sheet, Nursery Implements, misc and rounding off unforseen items and charges.
